Show the manual page of slipway or of one of its commands with man(1).
The pages ship with the gem; --install copies them into a man1 directory and says how man(1) finds
them.

Usage: slipway man [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]...

Arguments:
  [COMMAND]...
          The command whose page to show, such as rollout undo.

Options:
      --path
          Print the directory of the bundled pages and exit.

      --install[=<DIR>]
          Copy every page into DIR, a man1 directory, or into
          ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/man/man1.

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h').

Examples:
  # Read the page of a command
  slipway man get

  # Install every page for man(1)
  slipway man --install

  # Print the bundled page directory
  slipway man --path

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
